paper_goal_alignment.direct_purpose: Determine whether current public structured data can form a project-first monthly panel and whether crawling remains necessary before Stata panel regression.

count_metrics.rule: Within an established repository/source observability interval, an absent monthly period key in an OpenDigger count metric is a structural zero (no corresponding events), because OpenDigger sparse metric output omits zero-valued periods.
caveats: Do not zero-fill months before repository/project exposure begins.
Do not zero-fill after observability ends or during unresolved migration/source loss.
A failed HTTP/API retrieval remains missing, not zero.
Use monthly metric keys for panel values; do not reconstruct monthly values from annual totals.

duration_rate_metrics.rule: Absent month key does NOT mean zero duration/performance. It means no estimable event population for that metric-month unless source-specific documentation proves otherwise.

missing_zero_semantics.implication: R1A attrition based only on explicit monthly key presence is superseded for event-count metrics and must not be used as final panel completeness evidence.

empirical_sparse_encoding_check.interpretation: Sparse monthly encoding is common. Annual and monthly representations are not always arithmetically identical; formal panel construction must use monthly series directly with version/provenance locks.

old_a3_frame.role: source/container discovery frame, not formal project panel
old_a3_frame.conclusion: Still not analysis-ready and should not be processed one-by-one as the primary project-acquisition route.

oss_compass_project_first_candidate_sour.caution: OSS Compass single-repository entries are curated analysis candidates, not automatically validated OSS project entities.

cross_coverage.old_intermediate_bug_note: A transient calculation printed 534 due to a null/string comparison error. It is superseded. Correct overlap is 84.
cross_coverage.implication: The old A3/OpenDigger frame undercovers the more project-oriented Gitee candidate space; 451 curated Gitee single-repository candidates lie outside it.

data_sufficiency_decision.targeted_api_future_condition: Only after a frozen regression variable is construct-critical and structured free sources are shown inadequate.

binding_blockers_after_r1b: coverage of construct-valid performance outcome variables
project-month variable coverage after zero-vs-missing semantics are correctly applied

next_stage.title: Curated Project-First Candidate Panel Coverage Audit
strategy: Start from the 535 unique OSS Compass Gitee single-repository candidates.
Deduplicate and apply pre-specified software-project/canonical-repository exclusions.
Bulk-audit 24/36-month structured monthly metrics from OpenDigger and OSS Compass where available.
Establish repository exposure start/end before zero-filling count metrics.
Compute realistic post-cleaning N projects and NT project-month observations.
If Gitee-only post-cleaning N is adequate for the literature-grounded Stata panel design, keep a Gitee-only frame.
If inadequate, prospectively evaluate the 1,769 OSS Compass GitHub single-repository entries under cross-platform controls before any crawler is built.
